source_says: Red Star: "One (0.25 ounce or 7 gram) packet of yeast contains approximately 2 ¼ teaspoons of yeast." Fleischmann's FAQ: "How much dry yeast is in a ¼-ounce packet?" "About 2-¼ teaspoons."
notes: Bob's Red Mill agrees ("Two and 1/4 teaspoons ... equals 1/4 ounce or one standard packet of yeast"); USDA's Food Buying Guide says "1 package (1/4 oz) = about 1 tablespoon", and SR Legacy weighs a packet at 7.2 g.
